The '''Rilkean mine''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mine]], that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]], to the south west of the [[Geddis mine]]. It operated during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
